bug_info.bug_desc: In padring.sv, the shared IOB0-3 muxing logic identifies the dedicated SPI pads using the wrong enumeration constants: DioSpiHost0Sd2, DioSpiHost0Sd3, DioSpiDeviceSd2, and DioSpiDeviceSd3. These constants are from the DIO signal enumeration space, not the physical pad enumeration space (dio_pad_e). They are used both in the dedicated-pad generate-loop comparisons and as indices into the physical pad arrays dio_in_o/dio_in_raw_o. As a result, the special shared-mode output muxes may be attached to the wrong dedicated pad, and the IOB0-3 input muxes may observe the wrong dedicated pad's normal/raw input, violating the fixed shared-pair mapping described in Section 5 of the padring specification.
bug_info.fix_hint: Replace all uses of the DIO signal enumeration constants with the physical pad enumeration constants in padring.sv: use DioPadSpiHostD2, DioPadSpiHostD3, DioPadSpiDevD2, and DioPadSpiDevD3 in the dedicated-pad generate conditions, in the muxed input source indices, and in the generate block names. This ensures all comparisons and array indices use the same dio_pad_e index space as dio_in_o, dio_in_raw_o, dio_out_i, and dio_oe_i, restoring the correct shared IOB0-3 pad connections.
